items.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
items.description: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.

items.title: How Spain's migrant crisis created a political storm - whipped up by social media
items.description: The Ceuta crossings have shaken Europe politically, exposing divisions over the sensitive issue of migration, the BBC's Sarah Rainsford writes.

items.title: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
items.description: The vessel with at least 250 people on board caught fire off Madura island.

items.title: Young guns for hire - the teenage hitmen recruited to kill across Europe
items.description: The Foxtrot Network is thought to be responsible for about 35 murders in Europe, and uses violence-as-a-service tactics.

items.title: The Sopranos star Vincent Pastore dies aged 80
items.description: Pastore, who played Salvatore "Big Pussy" Bonpensiero in the hit US show, was found at his home in New York City, US media report.

items.title: A bruising 24 hours - what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?
items.description: Pressure is building on Gianni Infantino. Can he survive as Fifa president after the implosion of the controversial World Cup investment plan?

items.title: Tourist plane crashes in Peru, killing 13
items.description: The small plane was flying over the Nazca Lines ​archaeological site when it crashed, according to local reports.
